notes: Read all 8 source lines before editing. The web module is a barrel re-exporting eight Security & Access blocks: L1 SummaryStatsRow, L2 SecurityStatusCards, L3 WindowStatusDetail, L4 LiveVehicleState, L5 SentryModeChart, L6 SecurityStatistics, L7 EventHistoryTable, L8 EventTimeline. Every one of the eight exported names is preserved by the native barrel (each as `export function`).

Self-contained native port matching the established native devtools/index.ts + ingest-xray/index.ts precedent (.ts barrels that build trees with React.createElement, since JSX requires .tsx). The eight web siblings depend on a browser-only graph absent from the parity tree — lucide-react icons, @/components/ui GlassPanel/Badge/DataTable, @/components/data-display MetricCard/TimeStamp, @/components/feedback Skeleton/EmptyState, @/components/motion FadeIn, @/components/charts recharts BarChart stack, and @/lib cn/numberFormat/dateFormat/typeGuards + ./helpers — so each export is reimplemented with React Native primitives (View/ScrollView), the native AppText/GlassPanel/MetricCard, and theme tokens. No DOM-only modules, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, lucide-react, or old web UI components are imported.

SummaryStatsRow (L1): four headline MetricCards (status secure/unsecure, last lock change via ported timeSince, sentry uptime `${fmtInt(sentryUptime)}%`, total events). isLoading renders 4 skeleton blocks (web Skeleton height 88). The web MetricCard `color` (green/cyan/blue/purple/red) + lucide icon map to the native MetricCard 3-tone palette via metricTone() with its indicator dot standing in for the icon; the native-required `helper` is '' since the web cards have no subtitle. Every i18n key + English fallback preserved (admin.security.stat.status/secure/unsecure/lastLock/sentryUptime/totalEvents).

SecurityStatusCards (L2): six GlassPanel status cards (lock/sentry/doors/windows/homelink/guest) with a colored indicator dot for the lucide icon, the same big colored value and muted description. isLoading → 6 skeletons (height 120). Preserves every truthiness branch incl. latest?.locked/sentryMode/homelinkNearby/guestMode, doorClosed(latest?.doorState) green-vs-amber with asNonEmptyString(doorState) ?? 'Open' fallback, allWindowsClosed+windowSummary, and all admin.security.card.* / locked/unlocked/active/inactive/closed/open/nearby/away/enabled/disabled keys.

WindowStatusDetail (L3): the 4-up FD/FP/RD/RP window panels. WINDOW_KEYS, parseWindowState(latest?.[win.key]), the windowColor→windowStatePanel tint (green/amber/red/gray) and windowTextClass→windowStateTextColor mapping, and the `admin.security.windowState.${state.toLowerCase()}` key + admin.security.window.fd/fp/rd/rp labels are all preserved.

LiveVehicleState (L4): the useMemo(buildLiveSignals) grid is reproduced faithfully — all 10 signals (hazards/highBeams/turnSignal/driverSeat/pairedKeys/valetMode/serviceMode/speedLimit/homelinkDevices/centerDisplay) with the exact value + active logic (boolLabel, asNonEmptyString '...off' checks, count>0, speedLimitMode boolean|string branch). The lucide icon becomes an active-tinted cyan/muted dot; active value text is white, inactive muted. The 'Live' indicator and the message-only EmptyState (admin.security.live.noData) are preserved; admin.security.on/off/occupied/empty/indicator/liveState + all live.* keys kept.

SentryModeChart (L5): the recharts stacked BarChart (sentryOn=#3b82f6, sentryOff=#6b7280 verbatim) renders as proportional native stacked bars (per-day, normalized to max total) + a legend + a Time/Sentry On/Sentry Off accessible data table (the chart a11y fallback). Empty → common.noData. formatDateShort ported for the day labels; fmtInt for counts. PNG/CSV export, hover Tooltip, CartesianGrid have no native analog (recorded in nativeSecurityAccessBarrelCapabilities.sentryChart). admin.security.sentryChart + chart.sentryOn/sentryOff keys kept.

SecurityStatistics (L6): the seven aggregate MetricCards (lockEvents/sentryUptime%/doorOpenCount/windowOpenCount/homelinkCount/guestCount/total) with the same color→tone mapping; isLoading → 7 skeletons (height 80); null securityStats → common.noData. All admin.security.statsTitle + stats.* keys preserved.

EventHistoryTable (L7): the shared sortable, paginated DataTable becomes a native static table with the identical Time/Lock/Sentry/Doors/Windows columns and render logic — formatTimestamp time cell, Lock success/danger chip (locked?Locked:Unlocked), Sentry success/neutral chip (sentryMode?On:Off), doorClosed green/amber doors text with asNonEmptyString(doorState) ?? Closed/—, and allWindowsClosed green/amber windowSummary. isLoading → 8 skeleton lines; empty → admin.security.noEvents. Sort + pagination simplified to the full list (recorded in capabilities.eventTable). admin.security.eventHistory + col.* keys kept.

EventTimeline (L8): the scrollable derived state-change list (max-h-96 → ScrollView maxHeight 384, nestedScrollEnabled). useTimelineLabels is ported as timelineLabels() keeping every lock/sentry/door positive|negative title + subtitle key (door subtitle = ev.detail). The lucide icon circle becomes a variant-tinted (positive green / negative red / neutral gray) circular badge with an inner dot; formatTimestamp for the time. Empty → admin.security.timeline.noEvents.

Helper logic the components consume is ported inline from the sibling helpers.ts (asNonEmptyString from typeGuards, parseWindowState, doorClosed incl. bool/number/object/JSON-string branches, allWindowsClosed, windowSummary, timeSince) so the barrel renders without a separate helpers conversion; the helper TYPES WindowState/SentryDayBucket/SecurityStats/TimelineEvent are re-declared + exported. The page-orchestration helpers (buildSentryBuckets/computeSentryUptime/findLastLockChange/computeSecurityStats/deriveTimeline/isSentryActive) are NOT part of this barrel's export surface and stay with helpers.ts. SecurityEvent is imported from the already-ported native web-parity api/hooks/useAdmin (single source of truth).

i18n intent preserved via a native t(key, fallback, vars?) shim keeping every web key + English fallback and {{var}} interpolation. fmtInt ported from web numberFormat (safeNumber + en-US toLocaleString 0 fraction digits); formatDateShort/formatTimestamp ported from web dateFormat / TimeStamp with NaN '—' guards. framer-motion FadeIn is dropped (no native motion primitive — recorded in capabilities.animations).
